# IPTV Genie

> An IPTV player for Fire TV, Android TV, Google TV and NVIDIA Shield. It plays your own provider's Xtream Codes or M3U playlist: a sports guide matched to your channels, local channels first, recording, multi-view, no ads or trackers. It does not provide any content.
